input.command:
cd /mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/DupFind/runs/20261025.174005/build/DupFind/.drydock-probe && cat > probe.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
BIN="$(pwd)/bin/dupfind"
W=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$W/t/real" "$W/t/other"
printf 'same content here\n' > "$W/t/real/f1.txt"
printf 'same content here\n' > "$W/t/other/f2.txt"
# symlink to a directory holding a duplicate of real files, and a symlink to a file
ln -s "$W/t/other" "$W/t/linkdir"
ln -s "$W/t/real/f1.txt" "$W/t/linkfile.txt"
before=$(find "$W/t" -exec stat -c '%n %s %Y' {} + | sort)
echo "== listing with symlinks present"
"$BIN" "$W/t"; echo "rc=$?"
echo "== error path stdout (missing dir)"
"$BIN" "$W/nope" > "$W/out"; echo "rc=$? stdout_bytes=$(wc -c < "$W/out")"
echo "== error path stdout (file not dir)"
"$BIN" "$W/t/real/f1.txt" > "$W/out"; echo "rc=$? stdout_bytes=$(wc -c < "$W/out")"
echo "== read-only check"
after=$(find "$W/t" -exec stat -c '%n %s %Y' {} + | sort)
[ "$before" = "$after" ] && echo "tree unchanged" || echo "tree CHANGED"
rm -rf "$W"
EOF
sh probe.sh
